title: Extension feature removed — whole file documents a deleted surface
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely: all extension CSS, browser, and server payload execution is gone; the Settings surface, client hooks, shared marinara JS contract, and the /api/extensions routes were deleted; the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records; the authoring guides, examples, and Professor Mari instructions were removed. Verified upstream: packages/server/src/routes/extensions.routes.ts and packages/client/src/lib/extension-transfer.ts return 404 on main, and docs/extending/ now contains only custom-tools.md and regex-scripts.md.
fix: Re-frame references/extensions.md as a tombstone, not a deletion: retitle to 'Client Extensions (REMOVED in v2.3.4)', open with a removal statement, collapse the API reference/examples/patterns/pitfalls into a short 'historical (pre-2.3.4)' summary, and add a 'Where did extensions go?' migration section. Keep the file so the skill can answer why a user's extensions vanished.

title: marinara.storage 'durable' claim inverted — data is permanently erased at startup
reality: v2.3.4 startup permanently erases every retained server extension record and every extension-storage:* app setting; the file still sells marinara.storage as server-persisted, cross-device, durable state.
fix: Replace the marinara.storage section with an explicit data-loss warning: on first 2.3.4 startup all server extension records and extension-storage:* settings are destroyed, not migrated — there is nothing to recover in-app; legacy browser-local extension records are also removed by the UI-state migration. Users who need old extension code/config must retrieve it from a pre-2.3.4 backup or a prior zip export.

title: Missing migration guidance: themes survive, agent repos are the sanctioned third-party path
reality: Installed THEMES in Settings > Addons still exist (a separate 2.3.4 fix applies the chroma text color to installed theme names there), and disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories in Agents Manager (#3861 — manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, SSRF-safe archive validation) are now the sanctioned third-party distribution path alongside the reviewed Download Agents catalog.
fix: Add a 'Where did extensions go?' mapping: styling/theming → native Settings > Appearance + custom themes (/api/themes, Settings > Addons); arbitrary client DOM/JS scripting → no replacement (downloadable capability package or engine fork); model-invoked actions → custom tools; prompt/output text rewriting → Regex Scripts; third-party distribution → custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861) or the official catalog.

title: Decision guidance still routes 'I want the UI to do X' to extensions
reality: The 'When to Use Extensions vs. Other Surfaces' section and the closing rule recommend a feature that no longer exists in v2.3.4.
fix: Rewrite the decision list: UI styling → themes/Appearance; UI behavior/DOM additions → not user-extensible since 2.3.4 (capability package via the reviewed catalog or custom agent repo #3861, else fork); AI behavior → custom tool or agent. Also sweep decision-guide.md and custom-tools.md for the same dead routing.

title: Professor Mari can no longer build extensions
reality: The Professor Mari extension-authoring instructions were removed with the feature in v2.3.4; the file still says her workspace agent can create/edit browser extensions via mari db over installed_extensions.
fix: Drop the 'Mari can build extensions' claims; retain themes, agents, and custom tools as her authoring surfaces, and remove installed_extensions from the described mari db tables.

title: Settings > Addons > Extensions UI path and hot-reload workflow gone
reality: The extension Settings surface was deleted in v2.3.4; Settings > Addons now carries only themes. The Installation section, enable/disable instructions, zip import/export via extension-transfer.ts (file 404 upstream), and the hot-reload dev tip all describe removed UI.
fix: Fold Installation/Distribution and the hot-reload pitfall into the historical summary; state that Addons now lists only installed themes.

title: Source-of-truth pointer half-stale: CustomThemeInjector survives as theme-only
reality: packages/client/src/components/layout/CustomThemeInjector.tsx still exists on main (verified 200), but the extension-loading half the file documents (Blob ES-module import, globalThis.__marinaraExtensionApis registry, per-extension marinara API) was deleted with the client hooks in v2.3.4.
fix: Note CustomThemeInjector.tsx remains only as the custom-theme CSS injector; remove it as an extensions source of truth and delete the __marinaraExtensionApis loading description as live documentation.

title: Imported agents no longer bundle custom functions or self-grant tool access (#3953)
reality: v2.3.4 prevents imported agent files from installing bundled custom functions, granting themselves tool access, or overwriting a curated Agent by reusing its internal type. Agent exports no longer bundle function definitions, and imported agents receive a fresh custom identity requiring the user to review and explicitly attach tools afterward (#3953).
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note near 'UI Location'/tool attachment in custom-tools.md: exporting an agent does not carry custom function definitions; after importing an agent, tools must be recreated/attached explicitly — an import can never install tools or grant itself access, and cannot masquerade as a curated agent type.

title: Connection parameters note missing #3845 (Noodle defaults, top-k/reasoning-effort/verbosity)
reality: v2.3.4 applies enabled Connection generation defaults across every Noodle text-generation path and lets custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints receive explicitly enabled top-k, reasoning-effort, and verbosity parameters (#3845).
fix: Extend the 'Connection Custom Parameters (v2.3)' paragraph with a (v2.3.4) sentence citing #3845.

title: New conditional-macro operators and {{group}} macro undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 added || (OR), && (AND), parentheses, and equality-list shorthand to conditional prompt macros, plus a new {{group}} macro listing every other active chat character.
fix: Document in the skill's macro coverage (architecture.md 'Macros' bullet and/or character-cards.md macros section); optionally cross-reference from custom-tools.md.

title: Local ComfyUI video generation and workflow guide missing (#3804, #3749)
reality: v2.3.4 added local ComfyUI video generation for API-format WAN and other workflows with prompt, size, seed, frame-count, and uploaded first-frame placeholders (#3804), plus an in-app and GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide (docs/media/comfyui.md, verified present upstream) (#3749).
fix: Update the skill's provider/video-generation coverage (architecture.md) with #3804 and cite docs/media/comfyui.md as the workflow guide (#3749).

title: PocketTTS server voices now directly selectable (#3786)
reality: v2.3.4 makes PocketTTS server voices directly selectable for global, character, and narrator assignments while retaining custom voice IDs, URLs, and paths, and aligns new setups with the compatible server's default endpoint (#3786).

title: TTS dialogue pause changed to whole seconds 1-60
reality: v2.3.4 changed the TTS dialogue pause control to whole seconds from 1 through 60, migrating legacy sub-second and no-pause values to the new 1-second minimum. No 2.3.3 pause note exists in custom-tools.md/extensions.md; document only the current form.
fix: Document the pause control in its current 2.3.4 form in architecture.md's TTS section.

title: NovelAI prompt review shows subject-count-resolved dimensions (#3758)
reality: v2.3.4 makes image prompt review display the subject-count-resolved dimensions actually sent to native NovelAI, keeps Prompt Prefix count tokens out of scene sizing, and fills new NovelAI settings for legacy partial profiles (#3758).

title: Regex Scripts section still contrasts against 'UI extension' and cites a moved doc
reality: With extensions removed in v2.3.4, the 'not a custom tool, and not a UI extension' routing aside references a nonexistent surface; the cited docs/REGEX_SCRIPTS.md is 404 upstream — the doc now lives at docs/extending/regex-scripts.md (verified).
fix: Drop or rephrase the 'not a UI extension' contrast and update the regex source-of-truth path to docs/extending/regex-scripts.md.
